title: Sales Agency Agreement

issues.quote: (automatic numbering on every section paragraph, from "Appointment." through "General.")
issues.why: Word automatic numbering (paragraph styles "Agency Section" and "Agency Subsection", linked to list numId 77) numbers the 8 sections 1. to 8. and the subsection (a). The numbers are not typed in the text. House rule 3: a contract without articles numbers its sections A., B., C. and subsections 1., 2.
issues.fix: Change the list levels to A. (sections) and 1. (subsections), or replace the automatic numbering with the house scheme.

issues.quote: Chargebacks.  If a customer returns a Product for credit, Manufacturer may deduct the commission that Manufacturer paid on that Product from Agent's next commission payment.
issues.why: Only child in the automatic numbering: the section headed "Commissions." has 1 subsection, "(a) Chargebacks.", and no (b). House rule 3 bans a level with 1 item.
issues.fix: Fold the chargeback sentence into the "Commissions" section text, or split the section into at least 2 subsections.

issues.quote: This sales agency agreement (this "Agreement") is dated June 7, 2027, and is between Corrigan Fluidics, Inc., a Wisconsin corporation ("Manufacturer"), and Delacroix Sales Group LLC, a Louisiana limited liability company ("Agent").
issues.why: Defines the contract itself as "this Agreement" (MSCD 2.123).
issues.fix: Delete the definition and write "this agreement" in lowercase throughout.

issues.anchor: shall be for a term of
issues.quote: This Agreement shall be for a term of two (2) years beginning on the date of this Agreement.
issues.fix: The term of this agreement is 2 years, beginning on the date of this agreement.

issues.quote: This Agreement shall be for a term of two (2) years beginning on the date of this Agreement.
issues.why: House rule 2: digits only, never words with digits.

issues.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the other party thirty days' notice.

issues.anchor: shall have the right to appoint
issues.quote: Agent shall have the right to appoint one or more sub-agents in the Territory with Manufacturer's written consent.
issues.why: "Shall have the right to" uses "shall" for discretion.
issues.fix: Agent may appoint 1 or more sub-agents in the Territory with Manufacturer's written consent.

issues.quote: Agent shall have the right to appoint one or more sub-agents in the Territory with Manufacturer's written consent.
issues.why: House rule 2: "one or more" counts something, so it takes digits.

issues.quote: Sub-agents shall comply with Manufacturer's published prices and shall not quote any other price.
issues.why: Sub-agents don't sign this agreement, so "shall" can't bind them (MSCD 3.154).
issues.fix: Agent shall cause each sub-agent to comply with Manufacturer's published prices and not to quote any other price.

issues.quote: Manufacturer agrees to provide Agent with product samples, catalogs, and technical literature at no charge.
issues.fix: Manufacturer shall provide Agent with product samples, catalogs, and technical literature at no charge.

issues.quote: Manufacturer shall promptly notify Agent of any change in the price list.
issues.fix: Manufacturer shall notify Agent of any change in the price list no later than 10 days before the change takes effect.

issues.anchor: Agent shall be entitled to a commission
issues.quote: Agent shall be entitled to a commission of twelve percent (12%) of the invoice price, less freight and taxes, of each Product that Manufacturer ships into the Territory.
issues.why: "Shall be entitled to" (a "shall" with no duty) hides Manufacturer's duty to pay the commission (MSCD 3.169).
issues.fix: Manufacturer shall pay Agent a commission of 12% of the invoice price, less freight and taxes, of each Product that Manufacturer ships into the Territory.

issues.quote: Agent shall be entitled to a commission of twelve percent (12%) of the invoice price, less freight and taxes, of each Product that Manufacturer ships into the Territory.
issues.why: Percentage stated 2 ways (words and digits); house rule 2 calls for digits once.

issues.quote: Commissions shall be paid on the fifteenth day of the month after the month in which Manufacturer receives payment from the customer for that Product.
issues.fix: Manufacturer shall pay each commission on the 15th day of the month after the month in which Manufacturer receives payment from the customer for that Product.

issues.quote: Commissions shall be paid on the fifteenth day of the month after the month in which Manufacturer receives payment from the customer for that Product.
Neither party shall assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party.
issues.why: House rule 8: "shall" with a negative subject reads as "neither party has a duty to assign."
issues.fix: Neither party may assign this agreement without the other party's prior written consent.

issues.quote: Neither party shall be liable to the other for any lost profits arising from the termination of this Agreement.
issues.why: House rule 8: "shall" with a negative subject; and no duty is meant, so use language of policy.
issues.fix: Neither party is liable to the other for any lost profits arising from the termination of this agreement.

issues.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Wisconsin.
All notices hereunder must be in writing.
issues.fix: Each notice under this agreement must be in writing.

traps.quote: Agent is not required to devote full time to selling the Products, and Agent may represent other manufacturers of noncompeting products.
The parties shall cooperate with one another in resolving customer complaints.
traps.why_correct: "One another" is a pronoun, not a count (house rule 2).

traps.quote: Agent shall pay Manufacturer a one-time fee of $1,500 for product training.
traps.why_correct: "One-time" is part of a word, not a count (house rule 2).

traps.quote: This Agreement does not create a dealership under Chapter 135 of the Wisconsin Statutes.
traps.why_correct: Statute reference, not an internal cross-reference.

notes: Section and subsection numbers come from Word automatic numbering (custom paragraph styles linked to a list definition), so they are not in the extracted text; issues 1 and 2 are anchored "[format]". The extracted text of each section begins with its bold heading ("Appointment.", "Term.", ...). Font is Aptos 12, left-aligned: no formatting issue. Parties are defined without articles, which is correct; "the Territory" and "the Products" are other defined terms and keep "the". The definition of "Products" sits inside the "Appointment" section; that placement is not an issue. "All notices ... must be in writing" uses "must" with a nonparty subject and is correct apart from "hereunder."
